page_title: CAG 3-2 TOR | Cagliari v Torino 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' This shall not pass! Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
90+4' Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari) tries to find Roberto Piccoli, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
90+1' It will be a corner kick for Torino.
90+1' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
89' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

89' Antonio Sanabria (Torino) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
88' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
88' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
84' Torino failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
83' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) will be replaced by Ali Dembele.
83' Referee Gianluca Aureliano has finally had enough of Paolo Vanoli and brandishes a yellow card at him!
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yann Karamoh (Torino) is coming onto the pitch as Nikola Vlasic cannot continue after picking up an injury.
81' Mergim Vojvoda (Torino) sends a cross into the box, but Simone Scuffet comes off his line to gather the ball.
80' Davide Nicola has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Alessandro Deiola (Cagliari) replacing Antoine Makoumbou.
78' 3 - 2 It's an own goal! Saul Coco (Torino) puts the ball into his own net.
75' It will be a substitution. Gvidas Gineitis (Torino) is ready to enter the pitch as Karol Linetty walks off.
74' 2 - 2 Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari) finds the back of the net. He plants his header into the top right corner.
74' Corner kick. Cagliari will have an opportunity.
74' The linesman points to the corner flag, Cagliari are going to take it.

73' Samuele Ricci (Torino) swept past a couple of defenders inside the box and tried to score in the left side of the goal, but great anticipation by Simone Scuffet allowed him to make a comfortable save.
71' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
70' Simone Scuffet reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Saul Coco (Torino) towards the roof of the net. Torino get a corner.
70' Gianluca Aureliano interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari). It's a free kick to Torino in a dangerous position.
68' Karol Linetty (Torino) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
65' Vanja Milinkovic-Savic (Torino) tries to play a long through ball into Antonio Sanabria, but the defence breaks the move down.
63' Substitution. Yerry Mina will be replaced by Jose Luis Palomino (Cagliari).
63' Davide Nicola prepares a substitution. Michel Adopo is replaced by Gianluca Gaetano (Cagliari).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Viola trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gianluca Lapadula (Cagliari).

62' Che Adams (Torino) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.

61' What a chance! The ball rebounds out to Karol Linetty (Torino) and his strike from the edge of the box goes narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Cagliari will have a goal kick.
61' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) produces a poor lofted pass into the penalty box. His attempt is easily thwarted by the defence.
60' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Gianluca Aureliano had an easy-decision to make.
57' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
55' 1 - 2 Karol Linetty (Torino) breaks through the defence and scores a brilliant goal from outside the penalty area after firing the ball inside the left post!
54' What was Adam Masina (Torino) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.
52' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) swings the ball into the box from the corner kick but it's a bit too strong and it goes out of play.

52' That was a brilliant piece of goalkeeping! Simone Scuffet dived superbly to block a header by Antonio Sanabria (Torino) from around the penalty spot. His effort was directed straight towards the left post, but Simone Scuffet pulled off a remarkable save! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Torino.
51' Michel Adopo (Cagliari) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Torino.
50' A quickly taken corner by Cagliari.

49' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) latches on to a lovely pass inside the box and fires towards the left side of the net, but the effort is smothered by the keeper. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a chance to score from a corner.
47' Che Adams (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Cagliari will have a throw-in.
46' Half-time substitution. Davide Nicola decided to make a change. Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) is replaced by Razvan Marin.
46' The whistle blows and Gianluca Aureliano starts the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' The resulting corner from Valentino Lazaro (Torino) comes to nothing.
45+2' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Torino show off their ball retention skills as they exchange one-two passes and the move is only interrupted when the final pass is intercepted.

41' 1 - 1 Antonio Sanabria (Torino) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the bottom left corner. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 1:1.
41' The referee points to the corner flag and Torino will take a corner.
38' 1 - 0 Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) scores a goal from the free kick from the edge of the box. His low shot heads towards the middle of the goal, but the keeper is unable to stop it.
38' Che Adams (Torino) brings his opponent down. Gianluca Aureliano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Cagliari win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
36' Cagliari take a short corner kick.
35' Zito Luvumbo (Cagliari) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
34' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.

32' The game is interrupted. Tommaso Augello (Cagliari) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Free kick. Torino will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
29' Torino can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

28' Che Adams (Torino) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat. Torino have been awarded a corner kick.
26' The resulting set piece from Cagliari is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
26' Roberto Piccoli (Cagliari) has a shot blocked from inside the box. Cagliari have a corner.
25' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Mergim Vojvoda (Torino).
22' Samuele Ricci (Torino) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cagliari.
17' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
16' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
15' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the top of net only for Vanja Milinkovic-Savic to dive and make a save.
14' Saul Coco (Torino) has tested the patience of referee Gianluca Aureliano and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

12' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) is left with the simplest of tasks from close in after a lucky rebound off one of his own teammates, but somehow he slams his shot well wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
11' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
10' A tremendous drive by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) from inside the box towards the middle of the goal looks like it's in, but Simone Scuffet makes a brilliant save.
8' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
6' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Torino.

6' Nicolas Viola (Cagliari) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. Cagliari have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
5' Wonderful movement by Cagliari. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
2' Nadir Zortea (Cagliari) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Torino will have the kick-off.
Gianluca Aureliano will referee today's match.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
